name: mcp-argocd
description: Argo CD MCP server (MCP 2026-07-28): status, sync, rollback, drift, AppSets; writes or read-only

argocd_token.title: ARGOCD_TOKEN
argocd_token.description: Argo CD bearer token (also accepts ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN or ARGOCD_API_TOKEN)

argocd_url.title: ARGOCD_URL
argocd_url.description: Argo CD base URL including any path prefix (e.g. https://argocd.example.com)

mcp_read_only.title: MCP_READ_ONLY
mcp_read_only.description: Locks the server read-only: write tools and write-workflow prompts are not listed and nothing lifts the lock at runtime. Shared name across the mcp-* servers; set it in the deployer's env
